Fetch the Wikipedia web pages for Moon and Eliud Kipchoge to extract the exact perigee value and marathon record details.
```python
moon_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon")
kipchoge_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge")
print(f"Fetched Moon: {len(moon_page)} chars, Kipchoge: {len(kipchoge_page)} chars")
```
